name: Results chart with a called-out spike
looks: On the posted confirmation card a small 'clicks this week' line chart draws itself left to right under a travelling dot, climbing unevenly before a sharp rise at the end. A rounded callout holds the peak day and its value beside the chart's last point, lightly filled under the climbing stroke.
build: data-infographic's spline: a Catmull-Rom curve through the week's points, drawn with strokeDashoffset and a dot following getPointAtLength from the master clock; the callout pill springs up at the end (response ~0.36, damping ~0.78) once the dot lands.
sound: A rising tone under the draw, with a soft pop on the callout pill.
prompt: Prove a result with a small, honest chart: a line draws itself across a short span under a travelling dot, climbing to a visible spike at the end, with a small callout naming the peak value right where the line lands.
